alternative_fix_sites: patchwork/hunks.py::Hunk.trimmed (build the remaining lines with a slice or comprehension instead of deleting in place)
notes: Trimming context lines for fuzzy application deletes them from the hunk's own line list instead of a copy, while the hunk keeps its start position. Inside one application, the fuzz-2 attempt trims an already trimmed hunk (too much context dropped, start off by one, offset +1 reported). Afterwards the patch set itself is damaged: a later application searches for context-less lines from the old start and can patch a different, nearer match (wrong section). A single application that succeeds at fuzz 0 or fuzz 1 is correct (public test). Copying the hunk inside the apply step fixes the apply symptoms but still fails the direct probe of the documented 'this hunk is unchanged' guarantee.
